concepts.title: Definition of Measurement
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Measurement is indeed the action of comparing an unknown amount with a known fixed amount called a unit.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Every measurement is made up of a numerical value and a specific unit of reference.
question_patterns: What does measurement mean?
Explain the two parts of a measurement result.
Why are standard units necessary for measurement?
How is a measurement expressed?

solution_steps.explain: Find the numerical value obtained from the measuring tool.
Determine the standard reference used, such as metres or kilograms.

concepts.title: SI Unit of Length
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, the International System of Units (SI) provides a uniform standard for measurement used globally, where the base unit for length is indeed the metre.
concepts.key_idea: Standard units ensure consistency and prevent confusion caused by varying body-part measurements.
question_patterns: What is the SI unit of length?
Name the system of units accepted worldwide.
Why was the metric system created?
Identify the standard unit for measuring distance.

solution_steps.explain: The International System of Units (SI) is the modern metric system.
The metre (m) is the fundamental SI unit for length.

concepts.title: Metre to Centimetre and Millimetre Conversion
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, a metre is indeed divided into 100 equal parts called centimetres, and each centimetre is further divided into 10 millimetres.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, Smaller units like cm and mm are indeed used for measuring shorter objects.
question_patterns: Convert metres to centimetres
How many millimetres are in a metre?
Express a height of {m_val} metres in cm and mm
Calculate the number of cm in {m_val} m

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the metre value by 1000 or the cm value by 10.

concepts.title: Kilometre to Metre Conversion
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, the kilometre is a larger unit of length used to measure long distances between places.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, One kilometre is exactly equal to one thousand metres.
question_patterns: Convert kilometres to metres
How many metres make {km_val} km?
Express the distance in metres
Calculate the value of {km_val} km in m

solution_steps.explain: Since 1 km = 1000 m, multiply the km value by 1000.

concepts.title: Metre to Kilometre Conversion
concepts.definition: Converting a measurement from metres to kilometres involves dividing the value by the standard factor of 1000.
concepts.key_idea: To find kilometres from metres, move the decimal point three places to the left.
question_patterns: Convert {m_val} metres to kilometres
Express the distance of {m_val} m in km
How many km is {m_val} m?
Calculate the distance in kilometres

solution_steps.explain: Divide the metre value by 1000 to get the value in kilometres.

concepts.title: Measurement with a Broken Scale
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, When the zero mark of a scale is not visible or broken, the length is found by subtracting the starting mark reading from the final mark reading.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, the actual length is indeed the difference between the two observed points on the scale.
question_patterns: Find the length if the scale starts at {reading_start} and ends at {reading_end}
How to measure with a broken zero mark?
Calculate the object length from readings {reading_start} cm and {reading_end} cm
What is the actual length of the needle?

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the starting point reading from the end point reading to find the true length.

concepts.title: Rectilinear Motion
concepts.definition: Motion where an object moves along a straight path is named rectilinear motion.
concepts.key_idea: Objects in rectilinear motion do not change direction; they follow a linear track.
question_patterns: Define rectilinear motion
Give examples of motion in a straight line
What kind of motion do soldiers in a parade perform?
Is a falling stone an example of rectilinear motion?

solution_steps.explain: Check if the object is moving along a straight line.
If the path is straight, it is rectilinear motion.

concepts.title: Circular Motion
concepts.definition: A type of motion where an object moves along a curved path so that its distance from a fixed center point remains constant.
concepts.key_idea: The object rotates or revolves around a fixed point at a steady radius.
question_patterns: What is circular motion?
Explain the motion of a fan blade
How does a point on a clock hand move?
Give examples of circular motion

solution_steps.explain: Find the fixed point around which the object moves.
Verify if the distance from the center remains the same during movement.

concepts.title: Periodic Motion
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, Motion that repeats itself at regular, fixed intervals of time is named periodic motion.
concepts.key_idea: The movement follows a cycle that happens again and again in the same time frame.
question_patterns: Define periodic motion
Is the motion of a swing periodic?
Give two examples of periodic motion
What kind of motion does a pendulum show?

solution_steps.explain: Determine if the object returns to its starting position repeatedly.
Check if the repetition happens after a fixed amount of time.
